int_name: N 5TH ST & N INDEPENDENCE MALL E

result.summary: The intersection features basic pedestrian infrastructure including marked ladder-style crosswalks, sidewalks, and traffic signals. However, the wide multi-lane roadway and significant crossing distance increase pedestrian exposure to vehicular traffic.

hazards.name: Long crossing distance
hazards.description: The wide multi-lane roadway increases the time pedestrians are exposed to traffic without a physical refuge.

hazards.name: Construction activity
hazards.description: Traffic cones and temporary lane shifts may cause driver confusion or unpredictable vehicle movements near the crossing.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the roadway beyond the immediate crosswalk

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised concrete island in the median to allow pedestrians to cross the wide roadway in two stages.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking or buffer lane to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility.

result.summary: The intersection features high-visibility continental crosswalks and a dedicated green-painted bike lane, indicating a planned pedestrian environment. However, construction equipment currently obstructs the sidewalk and curb area on one side, creating a temporary hazard for accessibility and sightlines.

hazards.name: Construction Obstruction
hazards.description: An excavator and traffic cones are positioned on the sidewalk and curb area, potentially blocking the pedestrian path and sightlines at the crossing.
hazards.location_in_image: Left foreground on the sidewalk near the crosswalk.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to reduce the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and turning vehicles.

interventions.title: Protected Pedestrian Detour
interventions.description: Ensure construction zones maintain a clear, ADA-compliant path for pedestrians that is physically separated from traffic.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval
interventions.description: Program the traffic signal to give pedestrians a head start before vehicles receive a green light.

result.summary: The image shows a wide urban arterial road with multiple travel lanes and a dedicated green-painted bike lane. While there is a marked zebra crosswalk and sidewalks on both sides, the overall environment is dominated by high-capacity vehicle infrastructure, including a large overhead gantry.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross at least four lanes of traffic without a median or refuge island, increasing exposure time.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground crosswalk spanning the width of the roadway

hazards.name: High-Speed Roadway Geometry
hazards.description: Wide lanes and the presence of a large overhead gantry create a highway-like environment that encourages higher vehicle speeds.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the roadway and overhead structure

hazards.name: Multiple Threat Risk
hazards.description: Multiple lanes in the same direction can lead to a situation where one car stops for a pedestrian but another in the adjacent lane does not see them.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the multiple travel lanes at the crosswalk

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median or refuge island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs at the crossing to shorten the crossing distance and improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Raised Crosswalk
interventions.description: Elevate the crosswalk to the level of the sidewalk to act as a speed table and increase pedestrian visibility.

result.summary: The intersection is equipped with high-visibility continental crosswalks, pedestrian signals, and a dedicated green-painted bike lane. While the infrastructure is modern, the wide roadway and parked vehicles near the crossing create potential visibility and exposure risks for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Visual obstruction from parked cars
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along the right curb may block the sight lines between drivers and pedestrians waiting to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the roadway, upstream from the crosswalk.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to improve visibility between pedestrians and motorists.
